notes: The presentative *there* stays with the finite verb even though the verse writes an explicit subject noun: the dummy is the construction's, not the subject, and the postposed *Tola* keeps its own unit (rule 17).
Three supplied *the*s (twice before *son*, once before *hill country*) sit on the construct nouns, no article morpheme standing anywhere in the chains (rule 29).
*hill country* heads on *hill*, which carries the lexeme and which the ASV writes alone for הַר elsewhere; *country* is the supplied generic (rule 31).
